name: Mouse Sensitivity Converter
summary: Match your aim between CS2, Valorant, Apex and other shooters.
metaDescription: Free mouse sensitivity converter for CS2, Valorant, Apex Legends, Overwatch 2 and more. See cm/360, in/360 and eDPI, all in your browser.
lead: Enter your sensitivity in one game and get the number that feels the same in another. The converter keeps your cm/360, the distance your mouse travels to turn a full circle, identical in both games.

list: Pick the game you play now and the game you are moving to.
Type your in-game sensitivity and your mouse DPI.
Leave Target DPI empty to keep the same mouse setting. Fill it in if the new game will run at a different DPI.
Read the converted sensitivity at the top, and the same-feel sensitivity for every other game in the table.

p: Every shooter turns the camera by a fixed number of degrees for each count the mouse reports. That number is the game's yaw. Turning a full circle therefore takes 360 / (yaw × sensitivity) counts, and the physical distance is that number divided by your DPI.

Two settings feel the same when the counts per full turn are equal. To convert from game A to game B, multiply your sensitivity by yawA / yawB. From Valorant to CS2 that is 0.07 / 0.022, so the CS2 number is about 3.18 times larger. That matches what players find by hand.

head: Game
Yaw (degrees per count)
rows: Counter-Strike 2, CS:GO, Apex Legends, Battlefield 2042, Team Fortress 2
Overwatch 2, Call of Duty (Warzone, MW3), Destiny 2

p: A few games do not use a fixed yaw. PUBG and older Battlefield titles calculate turning from your FOV with a formula, so a single multiplier cannot describe them. They are left out rather than converted wrongly.
Scoped and aim-down-sights sensitivities often use separate multipliers. This tool converts hip-fire only.

The yaw values are the ones commonly published for each game and cross-checked against the conversion ratios players measure. Games get patched. If a result feels off, trust a quick test in the shooting range over the calculator.

faq.q: What is a good cm/360?
faq.a: There is no single right answer. Many competitive players land between 25 and 45 cm per full turn. What matters more is keeping it the same when you switch games, which is what this converter is for.

faq.q: Does FOV change the conversion?
faq.a: Not for the numbers here. These games use a fixed yaw, so the same counts always turn the same angle. The view looks wider or narrower, but your muscle memory for a full turn is unaffected. If you also change your display's aspect ratio, the FOV calculator covers that.

faq.q: What is eDPI?
faq.a: DPI multiplied by in-game sensitivity. It lets you compare two setups in the same game regardless of mouse hardware. A different game needs a conversion first, because its yaw is different.

zh.name: 鼠标灵敏度换算
zh.metaTitle: 鼠标灵敏度换算：各游戏之间的 cm/360
zh.summary: 在 CS2、Valorant、Apex 等射击游戏之间对齐手感。
zh.metaDescription: 免费的鼠标灵敏度换算工具，支持 CS2、Valorant、Apex 英雄、守望先锋 2 等，直接给出 cm/360、英寸/360 与 eDPI，全部在浏览器里计算。
zh.lead: 在一个游戏里输入灵敏度，得到另一个游戏里手感相同的数值。换算保持 cm/360 不变——鼠标转一整圈要移动的距离，两个游戏完全一致。

list: 选你现在玩的游戏，再选要换到的游戏。
填上游戏内灵敏度和鼠标 DPI。
目标 DPI 留空就保持现在的鼠标设置；如果新游戏要用别的 DPI，再填进去。
顶部是换算结果，表格里是同一手感在其他每个游戏里的数值。

p: 每个射击游戏都会按鼠标上报的每一个计数转动固定角度，这个角度就是游戏的 yaw。转一整圈需要的计数是 360 / (yaw × 灵敏度)，再除以 DPI 就是物理距离。
两个设置手感相同，指的是每转一圈的计数相同。从 A 换到 B，把灵敏度乘以 yawA / yawB。Valorant 换 CS2 是 0.07 / 0.022，约 3.18 倍，和玩家手动试出来的比例一致。

head: 游戏
yaw（每个计数转动的角度）
rows: CS2、CS:GO、Apex 英雄、战地 2042、军团要塞 2
守望先锋 2、使命召唤（战区、MW3）、命运 2

p: 少数游戏不用固定 yaw。PUBG 和老战地的转向由视野角算出来，一个倍数描述不了，所以这里不提供，也不硬凑。
开镜灵敏度通常另有一套倍率，这里只换算腰射。
表中的 yaw 是各游戏公开的常用值，并用玩家实测的换算比例交叉核对过。游戏会更新；如果结果觉得不对，以靶场里的实测为准。

faq.q: 多少 cm/360 算合适？
faq.a: 没有唯一答案。很多竞技玩家的选择在每圈 25 到 45 厘米之间。更重要的是换游戏时保持一致，这正是这个工具的用途。

faq.q: 视野角会影响换算吗？
faq.a: 对这些游戏不影响。它们用的是固定 yaw，同样的计数永远转同样的角度。画面看着更宽或更窄，但转一整圈的肌肉记忆没变。如果你同时换了屏幕比例，用视野角换算工具处理。

faq.q: eDPI 是什么？
faq.a: DPI 乘以游戏内灵敏度。它能让你在同一个游戏里比较两套设置，不受鼠标硬件影响。换游戏前需要先换算，因为 yaw 不同。

name: FOV Calculator
summary: Convert horizontal and vertical FOV between 16:9, 21:9 and 4:3.
metaDescription: Convert field of view between horizontal and vertical, and between 16:9, 21:9 and 4:3, plus the sensitivity multiplier that keeps your aim consistent.
lead: Field of view is quoted in two different ways. Some games show the horizontal angle, others the vertical one, and the horizontal number changes with your monitor's shape. This calculator converts between all of them.

list: Enter the FOV number from your game's settings.
Say whether that number is horizontal or vertical. Counter-Strike's 90 is horizontal on a 4:3 display. Overwatch's 103 is horizontal on a 16:9 display. Apex Legends' 90 is vertical.
Pick your display and the display you want to compare with.

sections.h: Why the same setting looks different on another monitor
p: Most engines fix the vertical FOV and stretch the image sideways to fit the aspect ratio. Horizontal and vertical FOV are linked by the display's shape: tan(h / 2) = aspect × tan(v / 2). A wider monitor therefore shows a wider horizontal view from the same setting.

Counter-Strike is the common exception. It fixes the horizontal angle for a 4:3 display, so on a 16:9 screen a setting of 90 becomes about 106.26 degrees. The calculator reproduces that: set the display to 4:3, enter 90 as horizontal, then convert to 16:9.

sections.h: Keeping your aim when the FOV changes
p: When the image is stretched to a wider view, each mouse count moves the crosshair the same angle but a shorter distance on screen. Multiplying your sensitivity by the ratio shown keeps the crosshair travel per centimetre of mouse movement the same. It is a starting point. Lower it if the new setting feels too fast.

faq.q: Is a game's FOV number horizontal or vertical?
faq.a: It depends on the game. Counter-Strike and other Source games quote the horizontal angle on a 4:3 display. Overwatch and Fortnite quote the horizontal angle on a 16:9 display. Apex Legends and Rainbow Six Siege quote the vertical angle.

faq.q: What FOV should I use?
faq.a: Whatever you can see comfortably. A wider view shows more but makes distant targets smaller. For competitive play many people choose the widest view that does not distort the edges for them.

faq.q: Does a higher FOV make the same sensitivity feel slower?
faq.a: Yes, the world moves more slowly on screen at a wider FOV. The sensitivity multiplier in this calculator compensates for exactly that effect.

zh.name: 视野角换算
zh.metaTitle: 视野角换算：水平、垂直与屏幕比例
zh.summary: 在 16:9、21:9、4:3 之间换算水平与垂直视野角。
zh.metaDescription: 在水平与垂直之间换算视野角，并在 16:9、21:9 与 4:3 之间转换，同时给出保持手感一致的灵敏度倍数。
zh.lead: 视野角有两种说法：有的游戏显示水平角，有的显示垂直角，而水平数值还会随屏幕形状变化。这个工具在它们之间换算。

list: 输入游戏设置里显示的视野角数值。
说明这个数是水平还是垂直。CS 的 90 是 4:3 下的水平角，守望先锋的 103 是 16:9 下的水平角，Apex 英雄的 90 是垂直角。
选你的屏幕，再选要对比的屏幕。

sections.h: 为什么同一个设置在别的屏幕上看着不一样
p: 多数引擎固定垂直视野角，把画面往两边拉伸来适配比例。水平和垂直由屏幕形状挂钩：tan(h / 2) = aspect × tan(v / 2)。屏幕越宽，同样的设置看到的水平范围越大。
CS 是常见例外：它固定的是 4:3 下的水平角，所以在 16:9 屏幕上设 90，实际约为 106.26 度。工具能复现这个结果：屏幕选 4:3，输入 90 当水平角，再换算到 16:9。

sections.h: 视野角变了，怎么保持手感
p: 画面被拉宽之后，每个鼠标计数转的角度不变，但在屏幕上移动的距离变短。把灵敏度乘以工具给出的倍数，准星每移动一厘米所需的鼠标位移就保持不变。这是一个起点，觉得太快就往下调。

faq.q: 游戏的视野角数值是水平还是垂直？
faq.a: 看游戏。CS 和其他 Source 引擎游戏给的是 4:3 下的水平角；守望先锋和堡垒之夜给的是 16:9 下的水平角；Apex 英雄和彩虹六号给的是垂直角。

faq.q: 视野角该设多少？
faq.a: 设到看得舒服为止。视野越宽看到的内容越多，但远处的目标会变小。竞技向的玩家大多选边缘不变形的前提下最宽的那一档。

faq.q: 视野角调大之后，同样的灵敏度是不是变慢了？
faq.a: 是的，视野越宽，画面里的世界移动得越慢。这个工具给出的灵敏度倍数正是用来抵消这个变化。

name: Steam ID Converter
metaTitle: Steam ID Converter: SteamID64, SteamID3, SteamID
summary: Convert SteamID64, SteamID3 and STEAM_X:Y:Z formats.
metaDescription: Convert a Steam ID between SteamID64, SteamID3 [U:1:X] and STEAM_X:Y:Z, and get the profile link. Paste any format. Free, works offline, nothing is uploaded.
lead: Steam gives every account several IDs at once. Paste any one of them and get all the others, plus the profile link.

list: Paste a SteamID64 (17 digits starting with 7656119), a SteamID3 such as [U:1:22202], a SteamID such as STEAM_0:0:11101, or a profile URL that contains the 64-bit ID.
Read the other formats below. Each has a copy button.
The conversion happens in your browser. The ID is not looked up online and not sent anywhere.

head: Format
Looks like
Used by
rows: Dota 2, CS:GO console, Source engine logs
Older Source engine tools, server configs

p: All three describe the same account. They are different ways of writing one account ID, with a few fixed bits in front of it that say public individual account on a PC. The 64-bit form packs those bits and the account ID into one large number. The other two are shorter ways of showing the account ID alone.
The account ID sits in the low 32 bits of the SteamID64. Dividing it by two gives the Z of the SteamID, and the remainder gives Y.

faq.q: Can it convert a custom profile name like steamcommunity.com/wolverine?
faq.a: No. A custom name can only be resolved by asking Steam's servers, which would mean sending your request online. Paste the profile URL with the 64-bit ID instead, which you can get from any profile page by opening it in a browser that is logged out.

faq.q: Why do SteamID64 numbers all start with 7656119?
faq.a: Those leading digits are not part of your account. They encode the account type and universe and are the same for every public individual account.

faq.q: Is it safe to share my Steam ID?
faq.a: Yes. Every format shown here appears publicly in your profile URL and in game logs. It is not a password and cannot be used to sign in to your account.

zh.name: Steam ID 转换
zh.summary: 在 SteamID64、SteamID3 与 STEAM_X:Y:Z 之间转换。
zh.metaDescription: 在 SteamID64、SteamID3 [U:1:X] 与 STEAM_X:Y:Z 之间转换，并给出个人主页链接。粘贴任意格式即可，离线可用，不上传任何内容。
zh.lead: 同一个 Steam 账号有好几种 ID 写法。粘贴任意一种，就能拿到其余几种，外加主页链接。

list: 粘贴 7656119 开头的 17 位 SteamID64、[U:1:22202] 这样的 SteamID3、STEAM_0:0:11101 这样的 SteamID，或者带 64 位数字的主页链接。
下面会列出其余格式，每一行都有复制按钮。
换算在浏览器里完成，不联网查询，也不上传。

head: 格式
长这样
用在哪
rows: 主页链接、多数现代 API
Dota 2、CS:GO 控制台、Source 引擎日志
较老的 Source 工具、服务器配置

p: 三者描述的是同一个账号。它们只是把一个账号 ID 连同前面几位固定标识（公开、个人、PC）写成了不同形式。64 位形式把这些位和账号 ID 打包成一个大数；另外两种只显示账号 ID 本身。
账号 ID 位于 SteamID64 的低 32 位。除以 2 得到 SteamID 里的 Z，余数就是 Y。

faq.q: 能换算 steamcommunity.com/wolverine 这样的自定义名字吗？
faq.a: 不能。自定义名字只有问 Steam 服务器才能解析，那意味着要联网。请改贴带 64 位数字的主页链接——用未登录的浏览器打开任一主页就能看到。

faq.q: 为什么 SteamID64 都以 7656119 开头？
faq.a: 开头这几位不属于你的账号。它们编码的是账号类型和所属域，所有公开个人账号都一样。

faq.q: 把 Steam ID 发出去安全吗？
faq.a: 安全。这里显示的每种格式都会公开出现在主页链接和游戏日志里，它不是密码，也不能用来登录你的账号。

name: Discord Timestamp Generator
summary: Make Discord countdown and date codes that show each reader's local time.
metaDescription: Generate Discord timestamp codes for any date and time. Pick a moment, copy the code, and everyone sees it in their own timezone. Reads codes too.
lead: Write a time in a Discord message and everyone sees it in their own timezone. Pick a moment below, copy the code, and paste it into any message.

list: Choose a date and time in your own timezone, or tap a quick pick.
Copy one of the seven formats.
Paste it into Discord. Other members see the time converted to their own clock.

p: A Discord timestamp is the number of seconds since 1 January 1970, wrapped in <t: and >, with an optional letter naming the format. <t:1700000000:R> shows a countdown that keeps updating on its own, which is why it is the usual choice for events.

faq.q: Does it work on mobile?
faq.a: Yes. Discord shows the same codes on desktop, browser and mobile, each converted to that device's timezone and language.

faq.q: Why does the code show a different time for me?
faq.a: That is the point. The code stores a single moment in time. Each reader sees it expressed in their local timezone, so 8 PM in New York shows as 1 AM in London for members there.

faq.q: How do I copy a timestamp from a message?
faq.a: Hover the timestamp in Discord and choose Copy Text, or reply to the message and read the raw code. Paste it into the reader at the bottom of this page to see the moment it refers to.

zh.name: Discord 时间戳生成器
zh.metaTitle: Discord 时间戳生成器：复制 <t:> 代码
zh.summary: 生成 Discord 时间代码，让每个人看到自己的本地时间。
zh.metaDescription: 为任意日期时间生成 Discord 时间戳代码。选一个时刻，复制代码，每个人都会看到自己时区的时间；也能反解别人发的时间戳。
zh.lead: 在 Discord 里写下时间，每个人看到的都是自己时区的时间。选一个时刻，复制代码，粘进任意消息即可。

list: 按你自己的时区选日期和时间，或者点一个快捷选项。
从七种格式里复制一种。
粘进 Discord。其他成员看到的是换算到他们自己时钟的时间。

p: Discord 时间戳就是 1970 年 1 月 1 日以来的秒数，包在 <t: 和 > 之间，后面可跟一个字母指定格式。<t:1700000000:R> 显示的是会自己走动的倒计时，所以活动通知最常用它。

faq.q: 手机上能用吗？
faq.a: 能。同一段代码在桌面端、网页版和手机上都会显示，各自换算成那台设备的时区和语言。

faq.q: 为什么这段代码在我这里显示的时间不一样？
faq.a: 这正是它的用途。代码里存的是一个时刻，每个读者看到的是换算到自己时区的写法：纽约的晚上 8 点，在伦敦的成员那里显示为凌晨 1 点。

faq.q: 怎么把别人消息里的时间戳复制出来？
faq.a: 在 Discord 里把鼠标移到时间戳上，选「复制文本」；或者回复那条消息，直接看原始代码。粘到本页底部的解读框里，就能看到它指的是哪个时刻。

name: Prompt Template Builder
metaTitle: Prompt Template Builder: Fill Variables and Copy
summary: Fill the blanks in ready-made AI prompts and copy the result.
metaDescription: Fill in the blanks of ready-made AI prompts for writing, coding, study and work, set each variable, and copy the finished prompt. Free, no sign-up.
lead: A good prompt is often the same sentence with the details swapped. Pick a template, fill in its blanks, and copy the finished prompt to any AI assistant.

list: Choose a template, or paste one of your own that uses {{double braces}} for its blanks.
Fill in every blank. The prompt on the right updates as you type.
Copy the prompt and paste it into your AI assistant.

p: Most weak prompts are weak for the same reason: they leave out the reader, the length or the tone and let the model guess. A template forces those choices up front, in the same order every time. You get consistent results because you are no longer re-inventing the instructions each session.

The templates here come from the prompt library of this site's earlier incarnation. Each one marks its blanks with double braces and was written for a specific task, from structuring a long article to reviewing a diff.

faq.q: Which AI models do these prompts work with?
faq.a: Any of them. A prompt is plain text, so you can paste it into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, a local model or anything else. Some templates mention a model in their notes because that is where they were tested, not because others will fail.

faq.q: Can I use my own template?
faq.a: Yes. Paste it into the box under the template list and write each blank as {{name}}. One input field appears for each blank.

faq.q: Is what I type sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The prompt is assembled in your browser and never leaves it.

zh.name: 提示词模板填充
zh.metaTitle: 提示词模板填充：填好空位直接复制
zh.summary: 给现成的 AI 提示词填空，复制成品。
zh.metaDescription: 给现成的 AI 提示词填空：写作、编程、学习、工作等模板都有，填完复制即可粘贴给任意 AI 助手。免费，不用注册。
zh.lead: 好用的提示词，往往就是同一句话换几处细节。选一个模板，把空位填上，复制成品。

list: 选一个模板，或者粘贴你自己的模板（用 {{双花括号}} 标记空位）。
把每个空位都填上，提示词会随输入更新。
复制提示词，粘到你的 AI 助手里。

p: 多数写得松的提示词是同一个毛病：没交代读者、长度和语气，让模型自己猜。模板把这些选择提前固定下来，每次都按同样的顺序给，结果就稳定，也不用每次重新想一套说明。
这里的模板来自本站前身（AI 万象）的提示词库。每条都用双花括号标出空位，并且是为具体任务写的，从结构化长文到代码审查都有。

faq.q: 这些提示词适用于哪些模型？
faq.a: 都能用。提示词就是纯文本，粘进 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、本地模型都行。个别模板的说明里提到某个模型，那只是它被验证过的地方，不代表别的模型会失败。

faq.q: 能用我自己的模板吗？
faq.a: 能。把模板粘到列表下面的框里，每个空位写成 {{name}}，每个空位都会生成一个输入框。

faq.q: 我输入的内容会被上传吗？
faq.a: 不会。提示词在浏览器里拼好，不会离开你的设备。
